test the TestProjectModelVersionsAPI class that retrieves model version prediction counts for a project
test the get_counts method that fetches project counts with include parameter filtering fields
test the model versions endpoint with no parameters returning all model version prediction counts
test the model versions endpoint with extended=true returning live and static version details
test the Project._rearrange_overlap_cohort method for overlap cohort assignment logic
test random tie-breaking in overlap cohort selection when feature flag fflag_feat_utc_563_randomize_overlap_cohort is enabled
test deterministic cohort selection when fflag_feat_utc_563_randomize_overlap_cohort feature flag is disabled
test that tasks with more annotations are prioritized into the overlap cohort for progress preservation
test that overlap cohort size equals the expected percentage of total tasks
test the ProjectSampleTask.post endpoint creates a complete sample task with annotations and predictions
test fallback to Project.get_sample_task when LabelInterface.generate_complete_sample_task raises an exception
test fallback to Project.get_sample_task when LabelInterface.generate_sample_prediction returns None
test that include_annotation_and_prediction=False bypasses generate_complete_sample_task and uses simple sample task
test that omitting include_annotation_and_prediction defaults to False and calls only get_sample_task
test ControlTagWeightSerializer accepts valid overall and label weights within [0.0, 1.0]
test ControlTagWeightSerializer rejects negative or above-max overall and per-label weights
test ControlTagWeightSerializer enforces three decimal place precision on overall and label weights
test ProjectSerializer.validate_control_weights rejects all-zero overall weights and accepts partial or valid weights
test ProjectSerializer.validate_control_weights passes through None and empty dict unchanged
test Project.objects excludes soft-deleted rows and Project.all_objects returns all rows
test Project.objects.for_user scopes to user's active org and excludes soft-deleted projects
test Project.objects skips soft-delete filter when deleted_at column is missing
test has_column_cached memoizes results and clears cache on signal
test signal_clear_column_presence_cache resets has_column_cached memoization cache
